messages:
Sam: Quick Q — thinking about saved queries in Console for per-route/per-model views. If a PM saves a view pinned to model X, should routing/quota hints reflect model-specific SLOs? e.g., show token burn estimates for the pinned model vs route default?
Maya: +1 this matters. We already show per-route cost, but not model-specific. UX question: do we show both or just "active model"?
Jordan: From API side we can add `model_hint` to savedview payload. Proposal: savedview { scope: route, model_hint: "open-vicuna-30b-q4" }
Priya: UX: showing both gets noisy. Suggest single prominent estimate (active model), with a small link "compare alternate models" that expands.
Alex: technical note: per-model token cost depends on quantization and runtime kernel. We can approximate with per-token cost table. e.g. code block:
```
model_costs = {"vicuna-30b-q4":0.0009, "redwood-7b":0.00015}
estimate = tokens * model_costs[view.model_hint]
```
Maya: Good. Also telemetry: we need to record when users switch model in a saved view (so we can A/B defaulting). add event: `savedview.model_switch`
Sam: How does this interact with routing fallbacks? If model not available, Console should show fallback and recalc cost, right?
Jordan: Yes. API will return `effective_model` in route metadata when capacity-bumped. Console should render a subtle banner: "Using fallback: redwood-7b — cost est updated" :warning:
Priya: +emoji :thumbsup: One more UX ask: savedquery share link should encode `model_hint` so teammates see same numbers.
Maya: Sounds like consensus. Action items: @Jordan add `model_hint` param + `effective_model` field to saved views API. @Alex produce a per-model cost table export. @Priya I'll wire the compact banner + compare expansion. I'll follow up with mockups.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: endpoint savedviews-api v2 deployed to staging at 1717772060
Sam: Great, thanks everyone. I'll prep a short PRD with examples and link the mockups here when ready.
